column1: # How the English Piper voices should say words they get wrong. One word or name per line, then a
# tab, then a spelling that reads the way the word sounds. Capitals do not matter. Lines starting
# A third column is optional: the exact sounds, in eSpeak's own notation (' before the stressed
# vowel, @ for the "a" in "about", S for "sh", and so on). Words that have it are built into the
# dictionary the voices read with (scripts/build-espeak-dict.sh), which gets the stress right
# where a respelling cannot. Words without it are respelled when the text is read.
# Add a word only if a voice really says it wrong, and check it with
# scripts/pronunciation-check.sh. Keep it to the common local pronunciation. Corrections and
# new words are welcome as pull requests or issues, and a spelling alone is enough.
